command:
import asyncio; from datetime import datetime, timezone; from sqlalchemy import text; from src.database import async_session
async def m():
  async with async_session() as s:
    rows = (await s.execute(text("SELECT id, email, role FROM users"))).all()
    for r in rows:
      uid, email, role = r
      r2 = await s.execute(text('INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id, session_type, started_at, completed_at, total_questions, correct_count) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), :uid, \'assessment\', NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0) RETURNING id'), {'uid': uid})
      sid = r2.scalar()
      print(f'{email} ({role}) -> session: {sid}')
    await s.commit()
asyncio.run(m())
